findings: ActivityItem status is color-only: the leading bar and trailing chip are aria-hidden and the status category (secondary/error/warning) is conveyed purely by color, so a screen-reader user gets name/action/time but not the status. Consider a visually-hidden status word or accessible name when wired into a page. Non-blocking.

List-semantics contract is consumer-owned: ActivityItem renders a bare <li> and the <ul role="list"> wrapper is only guaranteed in the test harness, not enforced by the component. Document the wrapping requirement at the consumption site. Non-blocking.
